articles.summary: As AI becomes the interface for financial decision-making, the question is no longer who has access to the best models. It's who controls how those models are applied to real-world analysis. Skills are emerging as the mechanism that defines that control, moving enterprise AI from generating text to producing decision-grade output.
articles.title: The Execution Layer: Why Skills Decide Who Controls AI in Financial Services

articles.summary: The model is no longer the competitive advantage. Enterprise AI outcomes depend on what surrounds it. Find out how Moody's connected intelligence (the retrieval, evaluation, and governance infrastructure surrounding AI models) delivers reliable, auditable outcomes in financial services.
articles.title: Connected intelligence: Where enterprise AI actually gets built
